page.layout: One printed block: a library bookplate on a paper slip, centred. Above it, handwritten shelf marks and a price (not printed text, omitted). Lines of the plate: script title, then a line of roman type, then a spaced capitals line.
page.notes: Handwritten marks on the book cover above the plate ("Box 177", "Ove 37", "$550") are manuscript, not printed, and are left out. The script line "The Bancroft Library" is set in a decorative script face. A small stain lies below the plate. The page is an engraved or printed bookplate, with no page number, running head, catchword or signature.
